Step.Text: PURPOSE: Generic quick find driven by the toolbar search input. Replaces the per-entity Quick Find <Entity> scripts -- Perform Quick Find already searches the CURRENT layout's quick-find fields, so this works on any list layout.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PARAM: the raw search term (Get(ScriptParameter)) sent by the Web Viewer search box. Empty -> show all.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: LIVE SEARCH: called on every (debounced) keystroke, so it NEVER pops a "nothing found" dialog -- a no-match just yields an empty found set. No native search field, so no Go to Field / Exit False cursor management (focus stays in the WV input).

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Empty term -> reset to the full list.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: No matches. A Quick Find that finds nothing leaves the found set untouched; Show All + Show Omitted Only forces a consistent empty set. Silent -- no dialog during live typing.
